segments.text: Today we are here to know about guru principle.
What does a guru do?
Whatever you have, all the precious things within your – he discovers them for Your
knowledge!
Actually, it is all there – everything.
All the knowledge ,all of spirituality and joy are there right time . It's all contained
within you only thing the Guru does makes your knowledgeable about your own knowledge
about your own spirit. Everyone has the Spirit within himself, everyone
as a spirituality with his own. There is nothing that you get from outside
but before getting this knowledge
You are dealing or living in ignorance
In that ignorance, you do not know what treasure
You have got within yourself.
So the Guru's job is to make
What you are
That Is
The first step
That it starts
That awakening Within you
By which
You Know
This outside world
This all an illusion
and you start getting enlightened within yourself.
Some people get full light,
And some people
Get it gradually
Essence of all the religions is that
You should know your self
Those peoples who are fighting in
The name religion
We have to go an ask them
You have to inquire from them, did your religion make you know yourself?
If all the religions has said one thing
we'll do these things just so that they would be aware of themselves.
But people get into rituals
They think by doing this ritual
That they are near God
They live in ignorance and obscenity
About their self
And day in and out, work-out something which has nothing to do with yourself.
Lots of acrobats, prayers, pujas these things go on because it is all ignorance people
going paying them money they become very rich their interest only money They want
You take all your money, absolutely and make a fool out of you.
They pamper Your ego – with pampering up that ego
just start drifting into the ocean illusion
And you are drowned in to that illusion
thinking they're very religious
and you are just in connection with God, which we're not.
To know god is to first of all know yourself without knowing that
You cannot know god
That's essential
But when you know your self
The experience
Is not sufficient
The knowledge has come
And the guru gives a knowledge about yourself
Now you have to tally it.
You should find out whatever your guru has told, is he true or not?
Is its correct of no-t or just another illusion now in this ascent people get into lots
of problems. First and foremost is the ego problem, especially in West. Ego stands up
you start thinking that great! You are better than others
And there's something special about it
This ignorance
Is more dangerous
Than worldly ignorance I think
Because with the worldly ignorance you do feel
the consequences of wrong things.
But when you are halfway,
When your ignorance is that about yourself
and if going to a higher realm
then one should always understand
That's why we cannot have ego
Then what starts in Transpiction?
You start looking at yourself
What's wrong with you?
When understand that your have ego, start looking at yourself or when there is something
missing then also start introspecting.
This should be a very honest, some people in Sahaja Yoga at an early stage start thinking
that they are very great and don't need any introspect.
And their eyes again into the clouds of ignorance without achieving selfhood or I can call Self-realization
So you have to introspect, see for yourself what has been doing?
What is it with You ? How far Have You come?
How much, please don't translate just now all right you can do it later on.
You must hear with full concentration even if you dont understand
It will work
Now the style of such a person changes gradually how?
First offal
A person who is extremely aggressive
Hot tempered
And
Fuller ego
Starts becoming very gentle and mild
Another type which is frightened and afraid, very cautious start becoming fearless.
At that stage you have no fears – You are sure
That your on the right path And moving in a right line
Your not easily disturbed there But still
You have to rise higher and higher, where when you meditate
understand that there's something wrong within yourself.
Your have achieved your Self-realization
–you've got the blessings of self realization
…your health is good…
...You get all kinds of blessings which
You cannot count, all that is there.
But still you have to go further and then it's to understand the knowledge about Sahaja
Yoga.
Now, you have to understand through your mental capacity first of all.
And then we verify how far it is correct?
How for YOU have understood that?
How far you have worked right, how far do know.
And when start seeing yourself ,you start entering into the realm of bhakti .You become
a mild person ..become sweet person..
You don't talk too much...
You don't harass anyone, you are a very pleasant person – very gentle and understanding.
This person has to verify how he is behaving towards other people
Now the attention starts moving from one self
to another and you start seeing how behave,how do love.
What is the quality of your compassion?
When You Love somebody without any expectations just love then Your absolutely dedicated
to that person. Absolutely! You just obey, you'll do anything for them if there is
this love which we call as surrender – This Is Just the Love, Surrender is nothing but
The Love and That Love Which is extremely Joy-Giving
This bhakti starts, this dedication starts and you are cleansed by that bhakt.
All the bad qualities we have – I can call them all the deficiencies
You've got…all problems We understand
and you get over it. Now if see somebody with the same qualities,
With that same troubles
You in love of
That person try to tolerate
Such a person just tolerates
There is no aggression
And these people forgive
Realize souls go on forgiving
their capacity to forgive is tremendous, they do not bear any malice against anyone.
They don't have anger about anybody –they just go on tolerating and forgiving
This forgiveness it's a music I should say of your bhakti.
The amount of forgiveness these masters could have, can be seen from life
Christ. They are tortured, crucified most
Of the saints were tortured people never liked them and they
Were crucified but as you know that
That they never resented
Then it never take a revenge
They never did anything which was not compassionate.
The had compassion and compassion for such people they felt that, Oh God please forgive
them what are doing?
They don't know extremely compassionate – when it becomes their nature they become
people with complete peace. They are not disturbed, they're never disturbed
With whatever is happening and
think it's God's will because nothing can disturb them
Nothing can upset then
The just enjoy their devotion
Devotion to there Guru maybe
devotion to God. In that devotion they may write beautiful poetry,
They go on dancing
and singing because the peace is within
And
are enjoying themselves
When there alone
There never alone
They enjoy themselves, they know that we are one with the Divine and the blessing of the
divine anger.
Another thing is –they never take to artificiality- they're never worried ,never upset .They
are neither futuristic nor they think of the past, but They Are in The Present.
When They Are In The Present ,They're absolutely silent . If there is any problem or anything
happens to them then immediately go into thoughtless awareness that's what their
capacity is.
To become a guru you have to develop that personality, not be bound by anything – I'll
tell You my own example-I never hurry and am never bothered about time once was going
into America because if Your sure the Divine has plans for it then You are not bothered
The Divine is looking after you, so why to bother?
I was going into America and one child fell down.
And just about get up an go and broke his arm around
When i saw the child
Alright!
I'll put that child right
They said we are going in America
So I cured the child, took about half an hour and then I came out all right let's go to
airport.
They said Mother we are very late!
And i said Im never late lets'go We went there
To The Airport
&The plane by which was going Was Out of Order
so There another Plane Going Washington not New York
And I wanted to go through Washington only.
So just imagine how things work out and we call them sahaja, it has worked our Sahajya
that no…
That means its effortless but first of all your personality should be such
That your devotion is so great that Divine is compelled to look after you, compelled
To Look After You.
You have understand the divine force around and this divine force is absolute guarantee
For Your safety for everything what you want to do.
that, Mother you are very powerful.
You can become also a very powerful if get completely dedicated to the Divine work –
You will also have all the powers and The Divine will provide
All necessary work that you want to do,
Necessary time which we need.
Everything is provided by The Divine
But compassion when it extends from other people
to God or to Divine Person, or your Guru.
Then it becomes very easy-to live – very simple–no complications everything is sorted
out and you are not bothered about anything just close your eyes things work out.
Everything works out as if that's your will, but you don't have to will it.
Don' t haveto think about i-t. It just works our divine looks after everything
Looks aftereyour comfort
Looks aftereour health
And this Divine help
You do not seek, you don't ask for but your personality for which the Divine is responsible.
Your are a special responsibility of The Divine and it knows what's good or bad
about you.

and people told Me, Mother he is very negative. He will never come!
Will Never Come! All positive things
happen if the negative thing take place
then you begin use your compassion
If it's negative we'll use our compassion
And You solve problem
You can solve problems of Your own
Of your surroundings
of your community.
So now you have got your Self-realization, how far you've gone in that I don't know
and a complaint about women so many ladies they do not meditate but are looking after
themselves ,they're not realized souls and thats why men want to divorce them
because they think these women are good for nothing, and some men also
like that. To solve this problem
you have to compassion
And somehow or other with compassion
You should win over the partner of your life
After all
Men much more busy than Women
but women indulge into so many other things. They have to look after their family,
the children and everything
And there mind is involved in all such mundane
that they've no time
Without meditation you cannot rise
You HAVE TO meditate
People think now we got realization
so it's all right, no. Every day you must meditate because that is the cleansing – with
a cleansing we understand what is needed and not needed… You are cleansed out! That
is done by Divine but you must religiously meditate. Gradually, you'll find your meditation
will become very deep –you'l lbecome very-very deep and your powers will start
showing up when are anywhere negativity it will run away all sorts of problems can
can solve.
Whatever you want to do is available to You, whatever it's your desire
To help others or give someone –you just get
It!
This my own experience I'm telling.
You have to meditate at least ten minutes every evening and morning about five.
With complete devotion, with complete admiration I've seen some people here such Bhakti is
envelops you completely.
When You have that Shraddha, it's very miraculous
– It works so many miracles!
Is true some people were cured
only thinking of Me as a fact
but That doesn't mean
they had the Shradda at this level
But that means
They have to develop Shraddah
Now how do we develop a Shraddah
which is natural light

person who has been meditating and not me. They'll come to my puja all right, they

.They Go Out For Popularity but inside they have not yet traced their own self so at
At this development stage, you should be encouraged and understood that

That

Of love within you
I should say
Which spreads
Like
Gentle fire
which doesn't burn
It does not give heat
but cold
beautiful breeze like
feeling within, which makes you understand.

upto the point when it is
collective complaint then am little bit bothered
and i talked about this with the leader but otherwise
if one person comes & tell's-me this or that
I just tell that person to introspect yourself, it's not so.

What the use of finding faults off others?
By finding fault with other you are now going be helped try and find faults within

they talk like this I liked these ,I liked that
What about the spirit?
You like things you like that
Now what About your Spirit does it lie
Does It
Enjoy

This joy, this ocean of Joy is within you and when it starts stirring up

To express that like drizzle on your being
Its like grace
On Your Being
The love for other people enthralled

He had done these
he has done the

They want to develop Sahaja Yoga in their hospitals.
So you should also testify yourself
examine yourselves and find out about your self
what are you?
Say husband & wife
Now the wife meditates
she knows everything
She knows about her husband, what's wrong with him.
she doesn't tell Him anything – she tolerates!
…She does not complain…
..she just tolerated and this tolerance convinces the husband that he is a higher

that this is what she has achieved, a great personality.

The things which we do here never come into
minds of those who aren't developed

you must pray Sahaja Yoga
